=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1176-1206 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the review_unreachable_followup_sync body builder, the fallback `by_location.setdefault((loc_file.group(1), loc_lines.group(1)), bid)` keeps only the first block for each (FILE, LINES) pair. Rows rebuilt from the ledger on a same-head resume all have block id "-", so distinct unreachable findings at the same location all get the first block's reviewer text.
  WHY: The follow-up issue is the only place the stubbed findings' reviewer text survives, so the second finding's evidence is lost. Four reviewers rated this NIT and gemini gave no severity.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1127-1319 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: If `gh issue create` succeeds with unparseable output and the recovery `gh issue list` also fails or returns nothing, `ru_followup` stays empty, `ru_recorded` is never set, the ledger header UNREACHABLE_FOLLOWUP_ISSUE stays empty, and the next round takes the create branch again.
  WHY: A second follow-up issue is opened for the same PR, which breaks the "one follow-up issue per PR" requirement; the orphan warning logs it but does not prevent it. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR, the other three NIT, and the highest was used.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1228-1236 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The orphan-recovery jq `sort_by(.number) | .[0].number // empty` picks the oldest matching open issue, not the one just created.
  WHY: In a double-orphan case the ledger records the stale issue number while the fresh duplicate stays untracked, so later rounds comment on the wrong issue and may create more duplicates. minimax and glm rated it NIT; gemini gave no severity.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:review_unreachable_followup_sync, the Python that builds the follow-up issue body: by_location.setdefault((loc_file.group(1), loc_lines.group(1)), bid) and text = neutral(blocks.get(block_id) or blocks.get(by_location.get((path, line_range)), "") or "") | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The FILE/LINES lookup keeps only the first block per pair. Resume-rebuilt rows have block id "-", so two unreachable findings with the same FILE and LINES (different LENS and ledger ids) both get the first block's text.
  WHY: After a same-head partial resume, the follow-up issue shows the first finding's text under both headings and the second is lost; the fix is to match on (FILE, LINES, LENS) or use the fallback only when exactly one block has the key.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:review_unreachable_followup_sync, the create branch (gh issue create without URL, then failed gh issue list recovery; ru_outcome="orphan", ru_recorded never set) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The follow-up number is read only from the UNREACHABLE_FOLLOWUP_ISSUE ledger header. After a double failure the header stays empty, the entries stay "pending", and the next round creates again.
  WHY: A second follow-up issue is opened for the same PR, against the "one follow-up issue per PR" rule. It is rare (two failures in a row), and the orphan warning makes it traceable but does not prevent it.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: "§1: a security finding on an unreachable file still blocks the merge; it goes to the follow-up issue and also keeps the PR blocked for the judge."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, job deterministic-skip-merge (starts at line 1178). It needs a ledger restore and an unreachable-security hold check before the step at line 1330, which auto-merges via --merge --auto (line 1534) and --squash --auto (line 1577).
  Evidence of absence: The only workflow hunk adds REVIEW_UNREACHABLE_FOLLOWUP_ENABLED (line 2106). The job never restores the ledger or calls review_unreachable_security_hold_active. review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh never reads the ledger (DETERMINISTIC_SKIP="true" at line 1712 or line 1219). The holds cover only review_enable_auto_merge.sh and the rb_security_merge_gate wrapper in review_rb_judge.sh (lines 98-106). The agents.d and changelog claims are false, and the editor cannot write the workflow file.
- HARDENING (2 related items): scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh review_unreachable_followup_sync. (a) Use by_location only when the per-key block count is 1 (~4 lines). (b) Write a "pending-orphan" ledger sentinel and run the list lookup before create (~8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
